Bank Math Master.question: ১) Rahim and Faysal together can complete a work in 12 days. Rahim alone can complete it in 20 days. If Faysal does the work only for half a day daily, then in how many days Rahim and Faysal together will complete the work?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Rahim and Faysal together can complete a work in 12 days. Rahim alone can complete it in 20 days. If Faysal does the work only for half a day daily, then in how many days Rahim and Faysal together will complete the work?

Solution:
Rahim and Faysal together can complete a work in 12 days.
Rahim and Faysal together complete 1/12 work in 1 day 

Rahim alone can complete it in 20 days.
Rahim complete 1/20 work in one day 

Faysal's 1 day's work = 1/12 - 1/20
= (5 - 3)/60
= 2/60
= 1/30

If B does the work half a day, then he will do = 1/30 ÷ 2 = 1/60 in one day

Now, boths' 1 day's work = 1/20 + 1/60
= (3 + 1)/60
= 4/60
= 1/15

So, Rahim and Faysal together will complete the work in 15 days.

Bank Math Master.question: ৯) Piyal and Belal together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, Belal left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, Belal alone could do the work in how many days?

Solution:
(Piyal + Belal)'s one day's work = 1/3 part
(Piyal + Belal) works 2 days together = 2/3 part
Remaining work = 1− 2/3
= 1/3 part

1/3 part of work is completed by Piyal in two days
Hence, one day's work of Piyal = 1/6 part

Then, one day's work of Belal = 1/3−1/6 = 1/6
So, Belal alone can complete the whole work in 6 days.

Bank Math Master.question: ২০) Akash can do a piece of work in 30 days. He works at it for 6 days and then Rakib finishes it in 18 days. In what time can Akash and Rakib together finish the work?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question:  Akash can do a piece of work in 30 days. He works at it for 6 days and then Rakib finishes it in 18 days. In what time can Akash and Rakib together finish the work?

Solution: 
আকাশ ৩০ দিনে করে সম্পূর্ণ অংশ 
১ দিনে করে ১/৩০ অংশ 
৬ দিনে করে ৬/৩০ অংশ 
= ১/৫ অংশ 

বাকি থাকে ১ - ১/৫ অংশ 
= ৪/৫ অংশ 

রাকিব ১৮ দিনে করে ৪/৫ অংশ 
১ দিনে করে ২/৪৫ অংশ 

রাকিব ও আকাশ ১ দিনে করে (১/৩০) + (২/৪৫) অংশ 
= (৩ + ৪)/৯০ 
= ৭/৯০ 

সম্পুর্ণ কাজ করতে সময় লাগে = ৯০/৭ দিন

Bank Math Master.question: ২১) One pipe can fill a tank four times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 36 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in-
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: One pipe can fill a tank four times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 36 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in -

Solution: 
Suppose the slower pipe alone can fill the tank in x minutes
Then the faster pipe can fill the tank in x/4 minutes.
Part filled by the slower pipe in 1 minute = 1/x
Part filled by the faster pipe in 1 minute = 1/x/4
= 4/x
Part filled by both the pipes in 1 minute = 1/x + 4/x

Given that both the pipes together can fill the tank in 36 minutes.
Part filled by both the pipes in 1 minute = 1/36

1/x + 4/x = 1/36
⇒ 5/x = 1/36
⇒ x = 36 × 5
⇒ x = 180 min.
= 3 hr

Bank Math Master.question: ২২) Aman takes twice as much as Bimol or thrice as much time as Rafi to finish a piece of work. Working together, they can finish the work in 3 days. Aman can do the work alone in -
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Aman takes twice as much as Bimol or thrice as much time as Rafi to finish a piece of work. Working together, they can finish the work in 3 days. Aman can do the work alone in -

Solution:
Let, Aman, Bimol, and Rafi take 6x, 6x/2 = 3x, and 6x/3 = 2x respectively.

Now, 
(1/6x) + (1/3x) + (1/2x) = 1/3
⇒ 6/6x = 1/3
⇒ 1/x = 1/3
⇒ x = 3

So, Aman takes = 6 × 3 = 18 days

Bank Math Master.question: ২৪) Two pipes P and Q, when opened alone can fill the tank in 20 and 30 hours respectively. If both pipes are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Two pipes P and Q, when opened alone can fill the tank in 20 and 30 hours respectively. If both pipes are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?

Solution: 
Part of tank filled by pipe P in 1 hour = 1/20
Part of tank filled by pipe Q in 1 hour = 1/30

Tank filled by both pipes in 1 hour = (1/20) + (1/30)
= (5/60)
= 1/12

∴ Complete tank will be filled by both in 1/(1/12) hours
= 12 hours

Bank Math Master.question: ২৫)  If 12 men or 18 women can reap a field in 7 days, in how many days can 4 men & 8 women reap the same field?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If 12 men or 18 women can reap a field in 7 days, in how many days can 4 men & 8 women reap the same field?

Solution:
12 men = 18 women
1 men = 18/12 women
∴ 4 men = (18 × 4)/12 women = 6 women

4 men + 8 women = 6 women + 8 women
= 14 women

18 women complete the work by 7 days.
1 women complete the work by (18 × 7) days.
∴ 14 women complete the work by (18 × 7)/14 days.
= 9 days
